intro.label: 02 / SAVINGS
intro.heading:
Small habits.
Stronger futures.
intro.statement: A SACCO works because members save together. Each member builds their own balance, and the cooperative grows on the strength of those combined savings.

products.name: Special Saving
products.short: A specialized savings plan designed to reward savers with superior annual returns, ideal for significant future goals.
products.benefit: A specialized savings plan designed to reward savers with superior annual returns, ideal for significant future goals.
products.description: This specialized savings plan is uniquely designed to reward savers with superior annual returns. It is the ideal choice for achieving significant future goals. Key features include: Tiered High-Interest Rates: Exceptional annual interest rates calculated based on the amount of your deposit. Voluntary Participation: A flexible, self-driven savings plan that allows for deposits anytime and from anywhere. Withdrawal Flexibility: Full access to withdraw funds at any hour after an initial two-month saving period. Goal-Oriented: Specifically tailored for large-scale plans and major future investments.

products.name: Mothers Saving
products.short: A savings plan designed to encourage and support mothers with flexible daily, weekly or monthly deposits.
products.benefit: A savings plan designed to encourage and support mothers with flexible daily, weekly or monthly deposits.
products.description: This savings plan is specifically designed to encourage and support mothers, offering the following features and benefits: Flexible Savings Options: A dynamic system that allows for daily, weekly, or monthly deposits starting from a minimum of 20 Birr. Versatile Service: Acts as a family guarantee that can be used for children's education, medical expenses, and various emergency situations. Mobility & Accessibility: Deposits can be made anytime and anywhere; furthermore, funds can be withdrawn at any time after the first month of saving.
